boundaries: A PASS report proves repository bindings and deterministic routing, not creative approval.
All creative packages remain HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING and do not authorize generation or publication.
Semantic audio remains outside rules whose audio_dependency is false.
IN_PROGRESS is mandatory while existing local material still requires direct review.
PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_GAP is reserved for the state where only fixed-corpus evidence gaps remain.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when exact Shot/timecode review proves the full shared trigger, an unrelated same-trigger contrary directing choice, and opposite routing results.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add an unrelated continuous real-time route across at least three necessary zones whose waypoints and action chain remain completely readable in one field, making extra waypoint coverage the wrong choice.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: Fresh review found route candidates but no unrelated same-trigger case in the fixed corpus where one continuous field keeps every required waypoint and action legible and makes added waypoint coverage the wrong choice.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when exact Shot and timecode review proves both the cross-work directing mechanism and a contrary same-trigger coverage choice.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated public object-mediated contest or reveal with the same registration trigger and one same-trigger case where early target or witness registration should be withheld.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The fixed corpus contains other public proof or procedural demonstration scenes, but their triggers differ; it lacks both a second object-mediated public contest or reveal and a same-trigger case where early target or witness registration is the wrong choice.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when exact Shot and timecode review proves the shared return trigger, the contrary directing choice and a machine-routable non-applicability boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated same-trigger return from a distinct visible location where immediate primary-anchor and relation restoration would be the wrong choice.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The two reviewed works provide positive return-anchor patterns, while other fixed-corpus location changes have different primary triggers; no same-trigger instance shows that immediate anchor and relation restoration should be withheld.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when exact Shot/timecode evidence proves object identity/state, the dependent action, one cross-work support, and one same-trigger no-extra-checkpoint boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add unrelated support for a portable-object handler or function change that governs a dependent next action, plus a same-trigger case where one continuous person-object view already makes the state readable without a dedicated checkpoint.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus does not contain both unrelated support for a function-changing portable object and a same-trigger continuous-view boundary.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only after exact Shot/timecode review proves the shared comparison trigger, the alternative coverage, and why the comparative-field rule must not fire.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated, rights-cleared scene with multiple simultaneously visible referents whose comparison truly governs the next action, but where a separate comparative field would be the wrong coverage choice.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus has comparison candidates but no unrelated same-trigger case proving that a separate comparative field is the wrong coverage choice.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only after exact Shot/timecode review proves the proximity trigger, already-readable geometry, and the alternative coverage decision in a different work.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add an unrelated proximity scene with the same relation-change trigger where prior geometry remains fully registered, so another initial spatial master would be redundant.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus lacks an unrelated proximity case with the same trigger and already-readable geometry that makes another initial master redundant.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when both cases have exact Shot/timecode evidence and distinguish one versioned object from unrelated items.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one rights-cleared clip with a visually tagged source object transformed and handed across two people or zones, plus one same-surface independent-items boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus contains no second rights-cleared case that proves a visibly transformed object handoff and separates it from same-surface independent items.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when revised and unchanged repeats are separated by exact Shot/timecode evidence and change a concrete directing choice.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one rights-cleared revised-operation clip with a visible plan/configuration change and phase marker, plus one unchanged-repeat boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus lacks a second case with a visible plan or configuration revision and a matched unchanged-repeat boundary.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close when the positive trigger and the do-not-intercut boundary are both exact Shot/timecode bound and produce opposite routing results.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one rights-cleared same-trigger multi-thread scene whose simultaneous visible states are clearer in one continuous field than by intercutting.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus lacks a same-trigger multi-thread case where simultaneous visible states are demonstrably clearer in one continuous field than through intercutting.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when the shared trigger, opposite scale order and changed Coverage/Edit decision are all Shot/timecode bound.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one rights-cleared same-trigger detail-to-container support and one same-trigger geometry-first boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus does not provide both unrelated detail-first support and a matched geometry-first contrary choice under the same trigger.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only after both unrelated support and boundary are exact Shot/timecode bound without relying on dialogue or unauditioned sound.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one rights-cleared unrelated subjective-access transition and one same-trigger boundary where ordinary relation coverage must remain primary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: The reviewed fixed corpus supplies one subjective-access lineage but no unrelated support plus same-trigger ordinary-relation boundary without unauditioned sound claims.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when unrelated support and a same-trigger contrary case are directly auditioned, Shot/timecode bound, and separate audible state from unproved subjective ownership.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated same-trigger case where an auditioned information-state change occurs inside a necessary held picture, plus one case where a picture change is required at the same trigger.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: Direct audition closed the local sound facts, but the fixed corpus has no unrelated directly auditioned same-trigger support and contrary picture-change case.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when shared event ownership, perceptual tolerance, unrelated support, and a same-trigger non-alignment boundary are directly auditioned and independently timed.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated event requiring picture and auditioned audio-state alignment, plus one same-trigger case where comprehension requires different picture and audio timing.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: Direct audition closed the local event timings, but the fixed corpus lacks unrelated auditioned support and a same-trigger case requiring different picture and audio timing.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when the visual-first trigger and measured offset are directly established in unrelated support and an audio-first or simultaneous same-trigger boundary.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated scene that must register a new picture field before an auditioned audio-information change, plus one same-trigger case requiring simultaneous or audio-first disclosure.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: Direct audition established the local transition, but the fixed corpus lacks an unrelated picture-first case and a same-trigger audio-first or simultaneous contrary choice.

prioritized_evidence_gaps.close_condition: Close only when unrelated support and a same-trigger simpler-audio boundary prove that a recurring audio-state schedule changes a concrete continuity or edit decision.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.required_review: Add one unrelated multi-state sequence requiring an independently auditioned audio schedule and visual continuity ledger, plus one same-trigger case where one stable audio state is clearer.
prioritized_evidence_gaps.why_existing_material_cannot_close: Direct audition established the local state schedule, but the fixed corpus lacks unrelated support and a same-trigger stable-audio case that should not use the ledger.
